steps: Pressure in atm, volume in L, temperature in K.
Molar mass = mass × R × T / (P × V). Density = P × molar mass / (R × T).
O2 is 32.00 g/mol. CO2 is 44.01 g/mol. N2 is 28.02 g/mol.
